summary: Qatari-mediated US-Iran negotiations have reached a breakthrough with direct talks expected in Doha after preliminary understandings on nuclear program, Strait of Hormuz navigation, and financial incentives. Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei ordered armed forces to maintain combat readiness for "powerful confrontation" and respond immediately to any threat without geographic limitation. Israeli forces demolished homes of two Palestinian gunmen in Hebron who killed two soldiers on October 23, while Jordan reported casualties in a clash with a 14-member armed group infiltrating from Syria.
key_points: Qatari mediators held 12+ hours of talks in Tehran with White House contact, leading to expected direct US-Iran talks in Doha on nuclear program, Strait of Hormuz, and financial incentives. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9196, @Faytuks_Network/9204)

Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei directed armed forces to achieve "maximum deterrence" through combat readiness and immediate effective response to any threat without geographic limits. (Source: @N12chat/232565, @N12chat/232566)

Islamic Republic Army spokesperson Brig. Gen. Akraminia warned that a US "adventure" instigated by Israeli threats would expand the war beyond the US president's control. (Source: @shin_persian/11793)
Israeli military demolished the Hebron homes of two Palestinian gunmen who killed two soldiers and wounded three at a checkpoint on October 23. (Source: @manniefabian/59457)
Jordanian army clashed with a 14-man armed group attempting to infiltrate from Syria, inflicting heavy casualties on the infiltrators who fled back to Syria. (Source: @N12chat/232558)

Pro-IRGC channel Sabereen threatened to target the Iranian Kurdish opposition Khabat party in Topzawa, Iraqi Kurdistan, urging residents to avoid areas where Khabat members are present. (Source: @shin_persian/11781)
Coalition air defenses intercepted and destroyed a hostile drone over the Riyadh area in Saudi Arabia. (Source: @shin_persian/11791)

US RC-135W reconnaissance aircraft "OLIVE32" transited from CONUS to RAF Mildenhall and onward to Chania, Crete, while tanker flights from Al-Udeid, Qatar, flew non-refueling sorties to Tel Aviv, suggesting possible force posture changes. (Source: @shin_persian/11795, @shin_persian/11784)

sections.executive_summary: Qatari-mediated US-Iran negotiations have reached a breakthrough with direct talks expected in Doha after preliminary understandings on nuclear program, Strait of Hormuz navigation, and financial incentives. Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei ordered armed forces to maintain combat readiness for "powerful confrontation" and respond immediately to any threat without geographic limitation. Israeli forces demolished homes of two Palestinian gunmen in Hebron who killed two soldiers on October 23, while Jordan reported casualties in a clash with a 14-member armed group infiltrating from Syria.

points: Two C-130 transport aircraft landed at Mehrabad Airport in Tehran at 0805Z and 0819Z on 30 October, indicating sustained heavy airlift activity in the capital. (Source: @shin_persian/11794)

Fighter jet activity was observed over Dezful in Khuzestan Province at 12:20 local time (0850Z), suggesting heightened air readiness in southwestern Iran near the Iraqi border. (Source: @shin_persian/11796)

An Ilyushin transport aircraft landed at Mehrabad with its transponder off at 00:13 local time (2043Z), a signature often associated with covert or sensitive logistics movements. (Source: @shin_persian/11783)
UAV activity was detected over Urmia in West Azerbaijan Province at 05:57 local time (0227Z), indicating persistent drone operations in northwestern Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/11786)

Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei instructed senior commanders to ensure "combat readiness for powerful confrontation with enemies" and to respond to any threat at any level with "immediate and effective response, without geographic limitation." (Source: @N12chat/232565, @N12chat/232566)

Islamic Republic Army spokesperson Brig. Gen. Akraminia warned that another US "adventure" prompted by Israeli threats or inducements would widen the war and leave its end beyond the US president's control. (Source: @shin_persian/11793)

Two fishing boats belonging to Qeshm Island residents were attacked from the air by an "enemy UAV," leaving two fishermen missing; the boats are assessed as likely IRGC-affiliated civilian observers supporting maritime operations in the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @N12chat/232563)

The Israeli army confirmed razing the homes of two Palestinian gunmen, Mohammad Jaaba and Firas Jaaba, in Hebron who carried out the October 23 shooting at a checkpoint that killed Staff Sgt. Ron Yonatan Roytman and Sgt. Yuval Shai Svilem and wounded three other soldiers. (Source: @manniefabian/59457)
A refueling aircraft launch was detected from Lod (Ben Gurion Airport) which did not appear on radar tracking sites, suggesting a covert tanker or transport sortie. (Source: @redlinkleb/50761)

Over the past 48 hours, a small number of tanker aircraft from Al-Udeid Airbase in Qatar flew non-aerial-refueling sorties to Tel Aviv Ben Gurion Airport on standard tanker call signs, possibly moving personnel or equipment in preparation for potential hostilities with Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/11784)

A US RC-135W Rivet Joint signals intelligence aircraft, callsign OLIVE32, transited from the continental US to RAF Mildenhall in the UK and onward to Chania, Crete, positioning a key collection asset in the Eastern Mediterranean. (Source: @shin_persian/11795)

Israeli forces operated in Hebron today and demolished the two homes of the Palestinian gunmen responsible for the October 23 checkpoint attack, publishing footage showing one house being destroyed by controlled explosion. (Source: @manniefabian/59457)
Artillery shelling was reported in the areas of Hariss and Hadatha in southern Lebanon, as indicated by live map markers. (Source: @redlinkleb/50648)
Two electric drones were observed over Zibdin, Nabatieh, and Toul in southern Lebanon, prompting a request for identification. (Source: @redlinkleb/50758)
An alert was issued for drone activity over Baalbek, Bednayel, and the eastern mountain range, with the Lebanese Army monitoring the airspace. (Source: @redlinkleb/50625)
Warplanes were spotted over southern Lebanon, per live map indication. (Source: @redlinkleb/50649)
Signal scanning activity was detected over Beirut's southern suburbs and surrounding areas, with warnings for caution. (Source: @redlinkleb/50664, @redlinkleb/50738)
Jet aircraft were spotted over Soran in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq, indicating possible Turkish, Iranian, or coalition air activity in the area. (Source: @shin_persian/11785)

A pro-IRGC Telegram channel, Sabereen, threatened to target the Iranian Kurdish opposition Khabat party in Topzawa, Iraqi Kurdistan, and warned residents to avoid residential areas where Khabat members are present. (Source: @shin_persian/11781, @shin_persian/11782)

The Jordanian army reported casualties in a clash with a group of 14 armed infiltrators attempting to cross from Syria into Jordan under heavy fire; the infiltrators suffered many casualties and the survivors fled back to Syria. (Source: @N12chat/232558)
The Saudi-led Coalition announced its air defenses intercepted and destroyed a hostile drone in the Riyadh area. (Source: @shin_persian/11791)

Qatari mediators conducted more than 12 hours of marathon talks in Tehran on Friday, maintaining regular contact with the White House, with discussions set to continue in Doha on Saturday. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9196)

A breakthrough in US-Iran negotiations was reported, with a US delegation expected to join Iranian negotiators in Doha for direct talks after preliminary understandings on Iran's nuclear program, Strait of Hormuz navigation, and financial incentives, with China and Russia as potential guarantors. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9204)

US tanker aircraft from Al-Udeid Airbase in Qatar flew non-refueling sorties to Tel Aviv, possibly indicating a repositioning of the 25+ tankers stationed there away from the Gulf in anticipation of renewed hostilities with Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/11784)

sections.threat_assessment: The convergence of diplomatic progress in US-Iran talks with heightened Iranian military readiness directives creates a volatile deterrence environment. Mojtaba Khamenei's order for immediate, unrestricted response to any threat lowers the threshold for escalation, while Brig. Gen. Akraminia's warning that Israeli-instigated US action would spiral beyond presidential control signals Iranian intent to expand conflict geographically. Simultaneously, Israeli demolition policy in the West Bank and Jordanian border clashes with Syrian-based infiltrators indicate persistent low-intensity conflict on multiple fronts. The deployment of US reconnaissance and tanker assets to the Eastern Mediterranean and Gulf suggests preparation for potential contingency operations. Pro-IRGC threats against Kurdish opposition in Iraq risk expanding internal Iranian security operations across borders.
sections.regional_response: Qatar's intensive mediation, including 12-hour marathon talks in Tehran and planned direct negotiations in Doha, demonstrates Gulf commitment to de-escalation with China and Russia positioned as guarantors. Saudi-led Coalition air defenses actively engaging hostile drones over Riyadh reflects continued vigilance against aerial threats, likely from Yemen-based actors. Jordan's military confrontation with a 14-man infiltration cell from Syria underscores ongoing border security challenges and coordination with Syrian authorities. The Lebanese Army's monitoring of drone activity over Baalbek and the eastern mountain range indicates heightened airspace awareness amid Israeli overflights. US force posture adjustments, including possible tanker relocation from Al-Udeid, signal strategic hedging.
sections.intelligence_notes: Multiple Iranian air movements — C-130 landings at Mehrabad, an Ilyushin arrival with transponder off, fighter activity in Dezful, and UAV operations over Urmia — suggest elevated logistical and surveillance tempo. The detection of a tanker aircraft launch from Ben Gurion Airport without radar visibility raises questions about covert aerial refueling or transport operations. Pro-IRGC channel Sabereen's specific threat against Khabat party in Topzawa, Iraqi Kurdistan, provides actionable intelligence on potential cross-border targeting. The RC-135W "OLIVE32" deployment to Chania, Crete, positions a key SIGINT asset for monitoring Eastern Mediterranean and Iranian communications. Iranian fishing boat attacks in the Strait of Hormuz attributed to "enemy UAV" highlight maritime vulnerability and possible IRGC use of civilian vessels for naval surveillance.
